W.note: Flat spectrum primitives with a nice striped pattern fill avoid copying the logo, but the scattered generic shapes read as a shape screensaver, and the starburst's rotation seam likely pops because its 12-vertex path is not 45-degree symmetric as the source claims.

X.note: The dark ground with blurred brand-colored glows and staggered overshoot assembly has strong Figma energy and a clean keyframe match at 0 and 100 percent, but it rebuilds the Figma logo mark piece for piece, which the brief forbids.

Y.note: The assemble, explode and return sequence loops exactly with a subtle breathing scale, but it is a literal copy of the Figma logo on a plain grey ground, its backOut ease is dead code, and pieces clip at the SVG edge during the explode.

Z.note: Playful brand shapes with a Figma-style selection-handle square, starburst and gradient field capture the brand energy without any logo, with multi-layer choreography, per-keyframe easing that returns every element to its start, a click-to-pause control and a responsive container that holds up on phones.
